posts.altText: A serene hotel balcony overlooking Da Nang at dusk with warm lantern light.
posts.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a modern Da Nang villa balcony at dusk, warm lantern light glowing, comfortable seating, clean surfaces, peaceful urban backdrop.

posts.topic: The soothing touch of warm aromatic oils
posts.caption: Feel the tension melt away with our slow, flowing full-body aroma massage. Long, gentle strokes using warm aromatic oils calm the mind and prepare you for a restful sleep.
posts.altText: Warm aromatic oil being poured gently into open hands.
posts.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 photo in soft warm lighting showing clean hands holding a plain bottle, warm aromatic oil glistening, soft focus background of fresh clean linens.

posts.topic: Simple care advice for recovery after a busy day
posts.caption: Take time to hydrate and rest after your day exploring the Marble Mountains or surfing at My Khe. Proper care helps your muscles recover and keeps your body feeling light and renewed.
posts.altText: A glass of fresh water and a clean towel on a bedside table in soft light.
posts.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a tall glass of fresh water with a slice of lemon and a folded white towel on a clean wooden bedside

posts.topic: Vietnamese Traditional Massage for total relaxation in your room
posts.caption: Experience the classic Vietnamese full-body massage right in your hotel room. Enjoy soothing acupressure along the back and shoulders, gentle stretching, and rhythmic tapping to ease tired muscles, paired with warm natural oil. VND 500k for 60 min.
posts.altText: Hands performing a gentle massage with warm natural oil on a guest in a bright hotel room.
posts.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a professional massage treatment in a clean, sunlit Da Nang hotel room. Soft warm lighting, warm natural oil bottle, white linens, professional hands at work, calm and peaceful atmosphere.

posts.topic: Surf and Sport Recovery Massage after active days
posts.caption: Made for sore paddling shoulders, tight hips, and heavy legs after a surf at My Khe or climbing the Marble Mountains. Let our trained therapists bring relief directly to your villa. VND 600k for 60 min.
posts.altText: A bottle of warm massage oil and fresh towels on a clean wooden tray.
posts.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a clean wooden tray with a plain amber glass bottle of massage oil, rolled white towels, and small lotus flower petals, soft warm evening light.

posts.topic: Relaxing after a long flight to Da Nang
posts.caption: Unwind after a long journey without leaving your hotel. Our professional therapists come directly to you, bringing calm and soothing care to melt away your travel fatigue.
posts.altText: A guest resting peacefully on a comfortable bed with soft hotel lighting.
posts.imagePrompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a guest resting comfortably on a plush hotel bed, soft warm lamp light, clean white linens, peaceful and serene mood, no visible face.
